hooks.prompt: Context: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST: Determine if this session involved debugging or diagnosing a Zephyr issue (investigating crashes, analyzing logs, running GDB, inspecting registers). If NO debugging work was performed in this session (e.g. this was a grading, engineering, or testing session), respond {"ok": true} immediately — this hook only applies to debugging sessions. If debugging WAS performed, verify ALL required: (1) TRIAGE: failure domain classified with confidence. (2) INVESTIGATION: at least one specialist invoked. (3) EVIDENCE: every conclusion traces to artifact (register value, log line, memory address, config entry). (4) ROOT CAUSE: stated with confidence, OR ranked candidates listed. (5) FIX REC: actionable recommendation given. (6) NO MODIFICATIONS: no Write/Edit/flash operations. Respond {"ok": true} if complete, {"ok": false, "reason": "Missing: ..."} if incomplete.
